title: ShEx datatype constraint violated
intent: Same ShExJ schema as v007, but ex:alice's ex:name is an xsd:integer where the NodeConstraint requires xsd:string. Pairs with v004 (a SHACL refusal) so the same_admission falsifier is exercised on both validators: a refusal that is reached at a different S41 state, or carries a different typed reason, in one runtime than the other is as much a conformance failure as a divergent admission.
